instruction: From the most recent email in the Notes folder, extract the first image from the attached document and save it to /home/user/image_export.png

metadata.explanation: Task requires extracting the image with dimensions 860x732 from the Word document attached in the most recent email in Notes folder and saving it to /home/user/image_export.png. Verified by checking the saved image has correct dimensions (860x732 pixels) AND matching content using perceptual hash (ec64d19b8ee0d913) to ensure the correct image from the actual document attachment in the Thunderbird profile was extracted.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete verification coverage: Evaluator checks file existence, dimensions (860x732), AND content verification via perceptual hash

Content verification present: Perceptual hash (phash='ec64d19b8ee0d913') ensures the extracted image content matches the expected image from the email attachment, preventing false positives from arbitrary images
Correct getter logic: Extracts all required properties (exists, width, height, format, phash) from the saved image file using PIL and imagehash libraries
Correct metric logic: Compares dimensions with appropriate tolerance (5px), and verifies perceptual hash using Hamming distance with threshold of 5 bits
Proper parameter handling: Metric correctly accesses expected dictionary keys directly (expected.get('width'), expected.get('phash'), etc.)
Robust error handling: Getter returns safe defaults on errors, metric handles missing/invalid hash values gracefully
Semantic correctness: The combination of dimension + perceptual hash verification can reliably determine if the correct image was extracted from the correct source
